purpose: Measure repeatability and season-policy effects under fixed logical work, without altering forecast means or fitting weights
inputs: Exact prior-only point bundles/common openings and76appearance sidecars from the released PR40; no source feed or probability changes

preflight.source: frozen standingH6 state, origin-only inputs; total_points removed and no evaluator access
preflight.feasibility: All complete/legal/source-matched and no safety cap. Repeat differences must be reported, never hidden; no outcome-guided work-budget selection.

repetition_order: sequential complete matrix r1 then identical r2; no best-run selection
primary: decisionH6 minus standingH6: mean within each common opening over both repetitions, then equal-season mean

criteria.repeatability_required_for_stability_cla: All38deadline financial/action/provisional/source fingerprints and net totals match for every repeated case

secondary: matched adaptedSolio comparison with same mean/downside reporting
per-policy repeat fingerprint/score dispersion, conditional bound coverage, fallback and actual resource cost
dated PR40 control drift remains a separate wall-time study, not a random noise sample
safety: Wall-time/memory/storage watchdog limits are abort guards, never successful stopping rules or accepted partial fixed-work scores. Preserve every failure; mechanical repairs require documented appropriate uniform reruns, not selective seed retry.
native_admission: Explicit optional node/seed/parallel request and source receipt, only optimal/node-limit statuses. Declared dominated integral paid-slack canonicalisation extends to node-limit incumbents; default legacy remains strict. Root-node/probe caps do not equalise compute across formulations.
limits: Two reused historical years with two common openings, not four independent seasons or an untouched test
2024/25 common no-Assistant-Manager action space; original complete managers not reproduced
Different pinned embedded/native HiGHS runtimes and formulations; fixed nodes/probes are not identical CPU work
Root/presolve/heuristic effort is not node-count bounded; safety guards may invalidate a run
Expected-objective/global chip/season bounds remain unknown; no forecast-weight or normal weekly-default promotion
No new Dastan/OpenFPL/AIrsenal forecast claim, retraining, live team planning or future-game wait

sources.use: mip_max_nodes, random_seed, parallel, threads and safety time options
